## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish housing-market episode with Totalkredit's chief analyst Sune Malthe-Thagaard as the guest. He says Copenhagen apartment prices have fallen three months in a row and expects a peak-to-trough drop of about 5%, possibly up to 10%, with prices recovering in the second half of next year. Aarhus prices are still rising but showing early signs of slowing. Higher interest rates and coming housing taxes are headwinds, and he names an external shock, such as an AI-driven equity correction like the recent Nvidia turbulence, as the main downside risk. No stocks are recommended.
